result.title: Feed-Forward Adaptive Gaussian Splatting for Interactive Medical Volume Rendering
result.summary: Path-traced rendering shows CT and MR volumes with realistic lighting, but it restarts after every change of view, clipping plane or transfer function (TF), the map from voxel intensity to colour and opacity, which limits the frame rate. Feed-forward Gaussian splatting models such as RenderFM predict the Gaussians directly from the volume instead of fitting them to each scan, and are fast. RenderFM, however, handles only CT, runs its network again after every TF edit, has no clipping operator, and places its Gaussians on a uniform 3-mm grid that blurs organ boundaries and cut faces. We present RenderFM-Next, a feed-forward model that addresses these limits. One network handles both CT and MR. Its Gaussians are predicted once per volume: a new TF needs no pass of this network, and a clipping plane cuts them exactly, using operators from prior work. The model predicts coarse 3-mm Gaussians for the whole volume and refines them to 1.5 mm only where refinement improves the image. A small score head ranks the coarse Gaussians by how much refining them would reduce the rendering error; at render time the user chooses how many are refined, and those next to a clipping plane are always refined, which sharpens cut faces. We build a benchmark of about 2,000 CT and MR scans with path-traced references under clinical presets, TF edits and clipping. Our RenderFM-Next improves over RenderFM retrained on this benchmark by 2.8 dB on CT and 2.4 dB on MR and renders a 1600x1600 view in 4-6 ms. Refinement adds 0.30 / 0.69 dB over the same model trained without it (0.51 / 1.17 dB on cut faces), and refining a learned 10% of the coarse Gaussians matches a random 50% with 2.4x fewer Gaussians. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/renderfmnext/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RenderFM-Next，一种由体数据一次性预测高斯的 feed-forward 模型，统一处理 CT 与 MR，并支持精确裁剪面与按误差增益选择性细化到 1.5 mm，用于路径追踪级医学体渲染的交互式加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作目标是渲染速度与画质，表示是供光栅化的高斯几何而非承载推理状态的内部表示，也没有多模态推理、证据获取或停止决策环节；其「按误差收益排序细化预算」虽与动态计算略可类比，但联系过弱，不足以成为借鉴线索。
